todos.title: declare a generic function `first` that returns the first element or undefined
todos.hint: Put a type parameter in angle brackets after the function name and use it for both the array element type and the return type. The return type must admit the empty-array case.

todos.title: declare a generic type `Box<T>` with a `value` and a `map` method
todos.hint: A type alias can take a type parameter too. The `map` method needs its own second type parameter for the result, and returns a Box of that type.

todos.title: write a factory `box` that builds a `Box<T>` and implements `map`
todos.hint: Return an object literal with `value` and `map`. Inside `map`, call `box` again on the mapped value so the new Box gets the new type.

todos.title: declare `longest`, constrained so both arguments have a numeric `length`
todos.hint: Use `extends` on the type parameter to require a `length: number` property. Compare lengths and return whichever argument is longer.
